fixture.description: Owned generated 100000-file cache fixture; not a user corpus; 50 lines per file, original cs_bench generator unchanged

conditions.cache_scope: scoped source/index file data pages only; metadata is touched by setup/probes and not evicted; binaries, shared libraries and device caches are uncontrolled
conditions.cold: owned-file posix_fadvise DONTNEED then PROT_NONE mincore; verified only if all observed ranges have zero resident pages
conditions.observation_window: ranges observed sequentially; another process or readahead could repopulate earlier ranges before target launch
conditions.warm: one identical fresh-process query replay immediately before each warm measurement
conditions.process: fresh target and isolated resource helper per sample; helper and cache setup excluded from target timing
conditions.rss: POSIX high-water can include inherited Python pre-exec floor; resource helper never loads fixture inventories
conditions.comparison: RS count-only; rg occurrence counts for term/literal and matching-line counts for regex; rg emits per-file counts, included in target timing; untimed full path/count equivalence first
conditions.index_build: excluded, indexes must be constructed separately
conditions.p95: nearest rank; with 7 repetitions p95 is the maximum
